character_creation_rules.starting_abilities_rule: union of race ability_slots and class ability_slots; duplicate ability ids merged without duplicate grants
character_creation_rules.starting_alignment_classification: neutral/uncommitted initial state; alignment changes through gameplay
sources: user supplied MMUD Explorer runtime screenshots and observations (2026-07-10)
ImportedDatabases/WCCLabeledWBB/Extracted/wbbMMUD.DOC: game begins in NewHaven with no money and limited equipment available

alignment_evil_point_rules.attack_penalty_rule: Attacking a Saint or Good target adds 2 evil points. Attacking a Neutral or Seedy-or-worse target adds no evil points.

daily_cleanup.negative_ep_exception: When moving from Neutral toward Good/Saint (EP < 0), the base 2-point portion does not apply, per Classic documentation.

fiend_attack_lockout.rule: At 300 or more EP, character cannot attack again until EP falls below 300.

alignment_evil_point_rules.note: The 2 EP value is target-reputation-specific for attacking Saint or Good targets. It is not a universal cost for every evil action.

maximum_hit_points.formula: HEA/2 + level*class.hp_per_level + level*race.hp_bonus + con_adj + accumulated_hp_rolls + con_adj + MaxHP_ability
maximum_hit_points.con_adj: iVar=(HEA-50)*level; if iVar<0 then iVar+=15; con_adj=iVar>>4 (signed arithmetic shift)

initialization_policy.rule: Runtime creates level-one characters from generated Librarium race/class records, formulas, empty inventory/equipment, and race/class ability trees.
